```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{FibMemo}{$n,memo$}
\If{$memo[n]\ne\mathtt{UNKNOWN}$}\State\Return $memo[n]$\Comment{cache hit}\EndIf
\State $memo[n]\gets\Call{FibMemo}{n-1,memo}+\Call{FibMemo}{n-2,memo}$
\State\Return $memo[n]$
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
